name: example-flow
title: End-to-end cascade demonstration
interface: acceptance/fixtures/demo is a complete miniature build2me project (a tiny calculator) with one Done leaf, one Open leaf, and a sketched parent. Its acceptance test copies the fixture, implements the Open leaf, and proves the parent flips to Done by cascade.
nl_description: Executable documentation: the full life of a contract tree, from SKETCH_ACCEPTED to cascade completion, verified end to end.
